_comment: CNCF Allowlist + Backstage-approved licenses. CNCF list is pinned; additional licenses have per-entry approval. Allowed set is cncfAllowedLicenses ∪ approvedLicenses[].id

approvedLicenses.reason: Permissive, MIT-like — no attribution burden, Apache-2.0 compatible, OSI-recognized as copyfree. Chosen as replacement for MIT in npm ecosystem for its clarity on patent and attribution.
OSI-approved permissive — allows commercial use and relicensing with notice preservation, no copyleft. Used for Perl-ecosystem utilities, compatible with Apache-2.0.
Public domain dedication — waives all copyright, no attribution required. Applied to data packages (mdn-data, caniuse subsets) where attribution would be impractical.
Public domain dedication — equivalent to CC0 for code, no conditions. Used for small utilities where author opts out of copyright.
